blocks.text:
After arriving in Rio de Janeiro, you are transferred to your hotel. The rest of the day is free for your first impressions of the Marvellous City: feel its exciting life, or relax under the palm trees with a coconut water to the sound of samba. Whatever you are looking for, you will find it easily in Rio!

Rio has it all: green hills, blue sky, beautiful bays, islands and marvellous beaches. Brazil’s second-largest city after São Paulo and one of the most beautiful in the world, it is famous for Copacabana, Ipanema and Leblon, with their black-and-white mosaic promenades, where from early morning until late at night people play football and volleyball on the golden sand. Rio offers almost any sport, from golf, tennis and surfing to diving and hang-gliding; beach cafés serve coconut water and freshly squeezed juices, and local musicians often play on the beach.
